outside_window.finding: Del Sol completion (CP End Date 27 Sep 2026 17:00 WST, shareholder approval obtained 21 Sep) issues 803.6m Consideration Shares to the Nexus shareholders at nil cash plus at least 253.75m Del Sol Consideration Shares at A$0.04 against a 0.061 market. That is ~1.057bn shares, 57% of the 1,853.7m on issue. Only 50% is escrowed, so ~529m shares (28.5% of issued capital) become freely tradable against ~7–26m shares a day of turnover. The overhang is a multi-week supply effect and not something a one-session window captures. Inside the window, a completion headline has historically read as positive on this name, so the in-window sign is ambiguous and the size here is for the weeks after completion.
Negotiations for the DOE ASCEND-Sb award of up to US$18m (selected 18 Aug 2026) are ongoing, the company says there is no commitment, and there is no dated resolution inside the window.

The September-quarter Appendix 5B is due by 31 Oct. Cash is likely to fall from ~A$23.6m pro forma to low-teens A$m once Q3 burn (drilling at Dutch Mountain, the Del Sol restart, the Metso study) and the US$3m completion cash are paid. That puts the next raise, probably the Nasdaq Level 3 ADR offering targeted for Q4 CY2026, within one to two quarters. This is a financing question and not in this window.
